title: gChatGUI
description: gChatGUI added a GUI for gChat.
body:
gChat-GUI is the official, seamless addon for the gChat plugin. It completely transforms the default text-based /settings command into a beautiful, interactive, and user-friendly Graphical User Interface (GUI).

Give your players the premium experience they deserve by letting them customize their chat settings with just a few clicks!

🗂️ Included Menus
Personal Settings Menu (/settings)
The main hub for players. Toggle notifications and access the color customization palette.

Color Setup Menu
A visual palette featuring pre-set colors (Purple, Blue, Red, Green, Gray). Players can see exactly how their name and messages will look before confirming.

🚀 Installation
Make sure you have the core gChat plugin installed on your server.

Download the gChat-GUI.jar file.

Drop it into your server's plugins/ folder.

Restart your server.

Type /settings in-game and enjoy the new visual experience!

⚠️ Requirements
gChat v2.6+ (This is an addon, it will not work standalone!)

Java 17+

Spigot / Paper (1.17 - 1.21.x)
